A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RNE research and contain complete, readable main texts and Appendices A–J. Full-text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of their equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v5 reports original inference-time control, density-estimation and energy-training experiments in Section 4, with additional empirical analyses in Appendices F, G and I.

after.justification: v6 retains these original experiments, including molecular annealing, ligand design, maze navigation, image generation and solvation-free-energy estimation.

M1.justification: The RNE estimator, RNC importance weights, reference-process stabilization, energy regularization and CTMC extension retain identical formulas and procedures. The revised Dual SM attribution does not change any method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ALDP, LJ-13 and Gaussian-mixture targets, dual-target ligand design, pointmaze navigation, ImageNet-256 generation and ALDP solvation-free-energy task. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments. Dual SM remains the evaluated baseline in Figure 5; the newly cited Yu et al. work supplies attribution, not an additional comparator.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices F/I retain the same model configurations, sample counts, diffusion schedules, resampling procedures and evaluation metrics. The Dual SM objectives in Equations (282)–(283) are unchanged despite their revised attribution.

E4.justification: Appendix F retains the reference-process and importance-sampling ablations, annealing analyses, score/discretization-error tests and improved-kernel analysis. The discretization comparison in Figure 18 and endpoint-energy analysis in Figure 19 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting in Tables 4–5 is unchanged. Appendix I.6.2 specifies three repetitions and reporting means and standard deviations for the free-energy experiments in both versions; no statistical reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and the plotted results match across versions. For example, Table 5 retains TI estimates of 27.30 ± 0.45 without RNE and 29.28 ± 0.04 with RNE. Figure 19 is relocated without changing its results.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, bounds and proofs are unchanged. References formerly called 'Theorem' are corrected to match existing Proposition, Lemma and Remark labels, including Lemma G.2 and Remark G.3; the underlying statements and arguments are not revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims: RNE unifies density estimation, inference-time control and energy-based training, with applications to continuous and discrete diffusion.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reference-process stability and ESS/diversity tradeoffs remain unchanged. Appendix B retains the same limitations concerning finite-sample SMC bias, low diversity, target mismatch and the perfect-model assumption.

D1.justification: Appendices A and I retain the same pseudocode, implementation formulas, hyperparameters, network and hardware specifications, data processing and sampling details. The attribution edit introduces no new implementation or code/data-access information.

R1.justification: Appendix I.5 changes attribution from Dual SM proposing Time Score Matching regularization to Yu et al. (2025) proposing the loss and Dual SM adopting it. The corresponding reference, 'Density ratio estimation with conditional probability paths,' is added. Broader research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v6 changes appendix cross-references from 'Section' to 'Appendix,' corrects references to Proposition/Lemma/Remark labels, and rewrites the short Dual SM attribution passage. Section order and the overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 19 moves from the bottom of page 54 to the top of page 55, shifting Appendix J downward. The added reference and wording edits cause limited reflow; graphical content, captions and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v6 provides more explicit attribution for Time Score Matching in Appendix I.5 and makes appendix and formal-result references consistent with their targets. These are limited improvements in scholarly context and navigation. The methods, theoretical arguments and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
